song: 31 - Daft Punk - One More Time (Official Audio)
title: one ring a bar, the filter opens and the room lights up on the claps
story: One More Time at 123 BPM (beat 15.62 ticks): four on the floor, hard on every beat, the clap on 2 and 4 bright (centroid >0.21), open hats on the off-beats. Every kick is the same hit everywhere: the camera's fov punches in 16 degrees (24 on the prominent hits) and the room shakes, and the claps add a neon-abyss brightness strobe. The pre-roll is a sampled loop, so the camera is too: each bar it snaps back to the loop start and makes the same dolly-in and slide across the room, two bars in the full groove and, when the filter closes at 1879 (rms 0.18->0.07), the same loop from a lower station while the shake escalates on every kick. The drop at 2004 cuts to a low corner looking up; after it the camera cuts every two bars on the downbeat through low corner, high-over-the-floor and side-wall stations and back mirrored, creeping in between cuts, while the ring is reborn from a new origin each bar and the hue steps every half bar.
